### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>ProtonMail/go-crypto (github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto)</summary>

### [`v1.5.1`](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/releases/tag/v1.5.1)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1)

#### What's Changed

- Harden handling of malformed OpenPGP input in [#​332](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/pull/332)
- Ensure rsa key gen test works with go 1.27 in [#​334](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/pull/334)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1>

### [`v1.5.0`](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/releases/tag/v1.5.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/compare/v1.4.1...v1.5.0)

#### What's Changed

- Implement ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SLH-DSA in [#​316](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/pull/316)
- Bump github.com/cloudflare/circl to 1.6.3 in [#​302](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/pull/302)
- Ensure generated RSA key primes satisfy P < Q constraint in [#​305](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/pull/305)
- Add `Signature.IssuerKeyVersion` field in [#​310](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/pull/310)
- Fix RSA precompute after prime swap in [#​317](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/pull/317)
- openpgp: prevent panic when candidate identity has no self-signature in [#​313](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/pull/313)
- guard nil issuer key id when checking trailing signature in [#​320](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/pull/320)
- guard nil issuer key id on v2 message read path  in [#​319](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/pull/319)
- Don't panic on unknown AEAD mode in v5/v6 SKESK packets in [#​322](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/pull/322)
- restrict embedding to embeddable signature types in [#​325](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/pull/325)
- fix: Malformed session key decoding in PKESK in [#​330](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/pull/330)
- fix: Do not accept malformed ecdh sk input in [#​329](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/pull/329)
- fix: Reduce risk of invalid slice access in [#​331](https://redirect.github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/pull/331)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/compare/v1.4.1...v1.5.0>

</details>
